name: Aylien News API
tagline: AI-powered news search and analysis over a large media index
description: Aylien News API provides programmatic access to a large news and blog index with search, clustering, entity extraction, and sentiment analysis. Developers query current and historical media coverage via authenticated REST endpoints for monitoring, research, and content intelligence workflows.
